messages:
mia: Heads-up: EU pool firmware push scheduled next Tue 03:00->05:00 UTC. It affects the NIC driver update and will require rolling node reboots. We should plan for short egress flaps and a controlled burst policy to avoid customer impact.

raj: Is this the vendor queue fix we saw in staging? Any expected packet loss or route churn?

mia: Yes — vendor NIC queue fix. In staging we observed ~5% packet drops for ~30s on one rack during a warm reboot. Planning notes below to mitigate.

jordan: Can we pre-warm egress routes + prefix cache and run a canary on 2 racks first? Also think we should briefly scale the on-demand burst pool to 2x for 30m after each rack reboot.

nina: Cost note: 2x burst for 30m x ~10 racks ≈ $1.8k (rough). If we cross credit thresholds we'll need finance sign-off. cc @finance :money_with_wings:

raj: Ops steps (high level):
1) cordon -> drain (graceful)
2) run net-check and kernel sanity tests
3) reboot node, verify NIC driver came up
4) uncordon and monitor.
I'll paste the commands we used in staging.

raj: ```bash
# drain, reboot, verify
kubectl cordon node-123
kubectl drain node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
ssh node-123 'sudo systemctl restart nic-driver && sudo reboot'
# post-reboot checks
./scripts/net-check node-123 || alert-oncall.sh node-123
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: maintenance job scheduled for 2026-03-24T03:00Z -> 2026-03-24T05:00Z (eu-west1).

mia: Canary plan: reboot 1 rack at 03:00, observe metrics for 15 min. If stable, continue in 30-min cohorts. Abort criteria: tail latency P99 > 1200ms for >5min OR egress packet-loss > 2% sustained. Fallback: pin to previous golden image and route traffic to warm-backfill pools.

jordan: For external comms: notify Dedicated and Private customers 48h prior; include a note about a possible temporary 5-10% soft quota on burst if we hit anomalies. Also recommend customers avoid big launches Wed.

nina: I'll draft support playbook and SLO notice. Suggest enabling read-only fallback for embeddings endpoints for a rolling 2hr window after each cohort to reduce retries/cost.

raj: Monitoring checklist to add/update: egress_pkt_loss, conn_reset_rate, prefix_cache_hit_rate, p99_generation_latency, nic_queue_length, gpu_utilization. I'll create soft and hard alerts (soft = notify #eng-oncall, hard = page oncall).

mia: Post-maint tasks: run prefix cache warmup: ```python scripts/warm_prefix_cache.py --regions eu-west1 --size 1000``` and run a small rerank eval to sanity-check quality.

jordan: I'll be on-call for the window. Ping me in #eng-oncall if any alert fires. :thumbsup:

nina: FYI sales flagged a campaign Wed morning — I've asked them to avoid launches during the window and sent an early heads-up to key accounts.

ops-bot: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eu-nic-fw-maint

mia: OK — action owners: raj (runbooks + dashboards), nina (customer comms + support playbook), jordan (oncall), mia (orchestration + burst budget). We'll iterate on the doc and run one last preflight 6h before the window.
